sourceBusMapping.unresolvedQuestion: No accepted source defines how each five-bit CGB palette code becomes six physical source-data bits or whether an internal nonlinear/gamma lookup intervenes.

runtimeBoundary.policy: Preserve the exact 0-31 channel code and normalize only as code/31 for a dimensionless command coordinate. Do not claim a six-bit word or voltage.

diagnosticCandidates.constraints: monotone code ordering; exact endpoints and intermediate six-bit words unresolved

cgbDocumentedRails.notes: +13.6 V and -15 V are identified for LCD operation; 5 V also powers the CPU board

elements: separate source-driver analog and digital supplies
multiple standard gray-scale reference voltages feeding the source-driver path

prohibitions: Do not assign +13.6 V, -15 V, or 5 V directly to RGB555 endpoints.
Do not transfer the comparable module's VCOM, V0-V4/V0-V9, gate, or source values to CGB.
Do not call the dimensionless signed command coordinate a pixel voltage.

sourceLatchPhase.status: family-constrained; exact CGB LP edge unresolved

rowActivationDelay.units: PPU lines after the source latch
rowActivationDelay.status: unresolved separation between source latch and gate-row activation; excludes LC response

inversionTopology.status: REVC establishes a reversal-related signal name; exact CGB topology unresolved

runtimePolicy.stateLocality: Each R/G/B TFT command is local to one logical source pixel. No spatial electrical coupling, common-mode average, or DMG passive-matrix crosstalk is applied.
runtimePolicy.changedPixelSplit: Within one observation frame, the previous source command applies before the row activation event and the current command applies after it.
runtimePolicy.noScanDiagnostic: Apply the current source command for the full frame while preserving identical code endpoints, equilibrium, polarity magnitude, and WS1 static color.
runtimePolicy.staticColorBoundary: WS3 never edits or resamples the WS1 color LUT. Polarity sign has no static-color effect until a separately validated later mechanism consumes it.

selection.status: period-reconstruction-defaults-selected; no exact CGB panel constants claimed
criteria: remain causal and bounded within the declared line intervals
keep family evidence separate from CGB facts
keep constant fields and WS1 colors invariant
expose all unresolved discrete choices to sensitivity/debug reports
permit replacement by future synchronized CGB electrical/photodiode capture
